item.title: “Everyone Thinks I Owe Them Something”: The Economics of Nigerian Entitlement
item.description: In Nigeria, success is rarely personal; it’s a shared resource that instantly turns anyone in a decent financial situation into a lifeline for others. In this feature, we spoke to Nigerians whose stories reveal the economic and emotional weight of this entitlement, showing how expected generosity has become both a cultural badge of honour and a silent burden.
